Intakes in excess of approximately 80–100 mg day1 lead to a quantitative increase in urinary excretion of unmetabolized ascor-
bate, suggesting saturation of tissue reserves. It is difﬁcult to justify a requirement in excess of tissue storage capacity.
A number of studies have reported low ascorbate status in patients with advanced cancerdperhaps an unsurprising ﬁnding in
seriously ill patients. One study has suggested, on the basis of an uncontrolled open trial, that 10 g daily doses of vitamin C resulted
